title: Heart totem of undying
description: This resource pack changes the texture of te totem of undying to a heart one.
body:
# Heart Totem of Undying
Give your life-saving item a fun and iconic twist! This resource pack transforms the standard Totem of Undying into a Minecraft vanilla survival HUD heart, making your last chance at survival feel even more fitting and thematic.

### Why download it?

- Iconic Look: The classic Minecraft heart is instantly recognizable and feels perfect for a totem that keeps you alive.
- Clean & Vanilla-Friendly: Matches the default game's style, making it great for players who prefer a simple, cohesive aesthetic.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works smoothly with shaders, other resource packs, and all Minecraft versions that support custom textures.

Survive with style — and keep your heart beating!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
